positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Increased trading management products by 3 weather derivatives through implementing variable capacity panels to account for wind speed, rainfall, and other weather factors
•	Developed 3 flexible structures to shape forward prices for power commodity products, used in combination with commodity curve price points for more accurate Profit and Loss analysis
•	Collaborated with bank and hedge fund clients to expand trade search and reconciliation process by providing weekly updates, demo presentations, and delivery under 4 months
•	Added customization options to existing commodity products to allow for an extensive user trade booking experience
•	Utilized C#, .Net Framework, SQL, DevExpress API, DotTrace, Visual Studio, and SVN version control

positions.title: Developer Community Marketing Intern
positions.description:
•	Participated in an iOS Hackathon as a sponsor to promote Harman’s programmable speakers, resulting in 4 groups of developers expanding audio control through mobile app
•	Created videos with over 700 views to address common developer challenges using Harman’s Software Development Kit (SDK)
•	Showcased configurable speaker capabilities with 2 demo app videos, presenting smart homes integration and linking multiple speakers for Follow Me Audio
•	Organized an internal, company–wide Hackathon for SDK feedback and open–source sample apps

honors.title: The Honor Society of Phi Kappa Phi
honors.description: Phi Kappa Phi is an invitation-only honor society inviting the top 7.5% of juniors and top 10% of seniors  among all majors at participating universities, including UC Davis.

honors.title: Dean's Honor List
honors.description: Awarded for Spring 2014, Fall 2014, Winter 2015, Spring 2015, Fall 2015, Winter 2016, Spring 2016, and Spring 2017

volunteerExperiences.role: Group Counselor and Senior Group Leader
volunteerExperiences.description:
As a group counselor, I taught participants aged 13-18 leadership competencies, guided them with leading team tasks, and improve their outdoor/wilderness skills.

As a senior group leader, I kept communication between my youth staff and the adult staff, made sure planned activities were executed, and lead the 50 participants for group wide events.
